description: News is NOT a series_key column. Article/event streams keyed by theme and/or ticker. Charts start as headlines/list; derived count/sentiment series are optional later.

theme.notes: Theme pubs + keywords first-class from day one.

ticker.notes: Ticker overlays from day one via rotation queue (not all tickers every run).

charts.notes: Decide v2 after seeing list UX density; do not invent sentiment series until provenance is clear.
